name: Merge Up

features.name: Merging gems
features.description: Winning clusters merge into higher-level symbols that can merge again.

features.name: Cell multipliers
features.description: Free spins wins generate cell multipliers.

review:
The game that introduced BGaming's merging mechanic: gems on a 6x6 cascade grid. Winning clusters pay, then merge into higher-level gems, which can merge again – so symbols upgrade step by step in a chain.

Merging all the way to the top creates a scatter, and four scatters start free spins, where winning clusters leave cell multipliers. The base game is genuinely fun on its own, which is rare. Very high volatility, 5,000x max and a 97.25% RTP – one of the best we list.
pros: Excellent 97.25% RTP – among the highest published
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
